groups.title: The great projects that inspired Parallax
groups.note: Parallax does not use their code, only their ideas. The code it does adapt is credited above.

entries.name: Bazarr
entries.description: The subtitle search code for the first subtitle source is adapted from Bazarr's providers, and most of the subtitle features follow Bazarr's lead.
entries.author: morpheus65535 and contributors

entries.name: FFmpeg (Jellyfin build)
entries.description: The engine behind nearly everything Parallax does with video and audio: reading, converting, joining, thumbnails and playback. Parallax couldn't exist without it. The Jellyfin team's build adds hardware encoding support and Chromaprint for audio fingerprints.
entries.author: The FFmpeg developers and the Jellyfin project
entries.note: Included in the Docker image. The matching source code is available from the Jellyfin FFmpeg repository, at the release tag named in the Dockerfile.

entries.name: alass
entries.description: Lines subtitles up with the sound of a video (the default subtitle sync tool).
entries.author: kaegi

entries.name: ffsubsync
entries.description: The other subtitle sync tool you can choose in Settings.
entries.author: Stephen Macke

entries.name: NudeNet
entries.description: Recognises what is in a picture for Content Review. Parallax ships the small 320n model and can download the larger 640m one.
entries.author: notAI-tech
entries.licence: MIT on PyPI, AGPL-3.0 in the project's repository
entries.note: Its models are based on Ultralytics YOLOv8 (AGPL-3.0). The larger 640m model is downloaded by your own instance from the project's releases, not redistributed by Parallax.

entries.name: Ultralytics YOLOv8
entries.description: The model family NudeNet's detectors are trained from.
entries.author: Ultralytics

entries.name: ONNX Runtime
entries.description: Runs the content detection model on your processor.
entries.author: Microsoft

entries.name: 4xLSDIRCompactC3
entries.description: The Fast upscaling model. A pre-converted ncnn model from Upscayl's custom-models repository, bundled unchanged.
entries.author: Philip Hofmann (Phhofm)

entries.name: 4xNERVE_OTF_fidelity
entries.description: The Sharp upscaling model. The fp16 ncnn model published by its author, bundled unchanged.
entries.author: Philip Hofmann (Phhofm)

entries.name: 4xNomos8kSC
entries.description: The Natural upscaling model. A pre-converted ncnn model from TNTwise's Upscaling-Models-NCNN (Universal-NCNN-Upscaler), bundled unchanged.
entries.author: Philip Hofmann (Phhofm)

entries.name: ncnn
entries.description: The inference library that runs the upscaling models, on a graphics card or the processor.

entries.name: TMDB
entries.description: Supplies show and movie details, episode titles and pictures for Identify.
entries.author: TMDB
entries.notice: This product uses TMDB and the TMDB APIs but is not endorsed, certified, or otherwise approved by TMDB.

entries.name: GuessIt
entries.description: Reads season, episode and title out of messy file names.
entries.author: The GuessIt developers

entries.name: Babelfish
entries.description: Language codes and names.
entries.author: The Babelfish developers

entries.name: Python libraries
entries.description: FastAPI, Uvicorn, SQLAlchemy, python-multipart, Pillow, ImageHash, NumPy, Requests, Beautiful Soup, rarfile and watchdog.
entries.author: Their respective authors

entries.name: Interface libraries
entries.description: React, React Router, TanStack Query and Virtual, Video.js, Radix UI, shadcn/ui, Tailwind CSS, dnd kit, cmdk, Lucide, React Hook Form, Zod, Sonner, react-day-picker and a few small helpers.
entries.author: Their respective authors

entries.name: yt-dlp
entries.description: Powers Downloads, and the video-site side of Galleries. Installed from Settings → Downloads.
entries.author: The yt-dlp contributors

entries.name: gallery-dl
entries.description: Powers Galleries. Run as a separate program, never linked into Parallax.
entries.author: Mike Fährmann and contributors

entries.name: yt-dlp-ejs
entries.description: Helper scripts yt-dlp uses for some sites.
entries.author: The yt-dlp contributors

entries.name: curl_cffi
entries.description: Lets downloads look like a normal browser when a site needs it.
entries.author: The curl_cffi contributors

entries.name: Deno
entries.description: A JavaScript runtime some downloads need. Fetched on first use.
entries.author: The Deno authors

entries.name: Inter
entries.description: The typeface used for the titles on generated show artwork.
entries.author: Rasmus Andersson

entries.name: Playfair
entries.description: The typeface used for the large headings on this website.
entries.author: Claus Eggers Sørensen

entries.name: Jellyfin
entries.description: The naming rules Identify follows, so renamed files and folders are picked up correctly.

entries.name: Sonarr and Radarr
entries.description: The idea behind Identify: match a folder of files to a show or movie and rename it properly.

entries.name: Pinchflat
entries.description: The idea behind Identify's Custom mode, which turns any folder into a show.

entries.name: MeTube
entries.description: The idea behind the Downloads page.

entries.name: HandBrake
entries.description: The inspiration behind Compress, Splice and Toolbox.

entries.name: Blender open movies
entries.description: Short films shown in many screenshots: Big Buck Bunny, Sintel, Tears of Steel and Elephants Dream.
entries.author: Blender Foundation

entries.name: NASA Telescopes Reveal Hidden Universe
entries.description: Video clip shown in screenshots.
entries.author: NASA/JPL-Caltech

entries.name: Pioneer One
entries.description: The show name, episode titles and poster in the Identify screenshots come from this series, through TMDB. The video files in those screenshots are placeholder clips.
entries.author: The Pioneer One production team

entries.name: Photographs
entries.description: The pictures in the image screenshots.
entries.author: Omar Elsharawy, on Unsplash

entries.name: Anguish, Disquiet and Floating Cities

entries.author: Antonio S. Ribeiro, via Freesound
